name: zodiac-video-pipeline
description: Vietnamese Zodiac pipeline with semantic sticker assets, fixed handwritten Vietnamese overlay subtitles, thin runtime-pinned job packages, reusable Remotion cover rendering, and publish-ready local outputs.

interface.longDescription: Build or refresh approved Zodiac content, derive semantic reusable assets, compile full-canvas handwritten Vietnamese subtitles, and export data-only zodiac-job@3 packages that pin a shared Zodiac Studio runtime instead of duplicating renderer/library/reference files.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use skills/zodiac-video-pipeline/SKILL.md. Preserve approved insight/evidence. New ZIP exports MUST use zodiac-job@3: include package-manifest.json with exact runtime zodiac-remotion@1.14.0 hash 88f845a0e9304383ed6627127206185d301ba1516b1e16e591cbe1ba47c3d1f8 and matching design hash; include only production/narration/design/handoff/publish/used assets/receipts; NEVER copy renderer/**, library/**, references/** or node_modules/** into a v3 job ZIP. narration.txt must equal exact join(scene.voice, LF); caption_style must match design.md; FINAL_VALIDATION may claim PASS only after the same package gates pass. Studio owns shared runtime/TTS/timing/render/output.
